**Paperhue 0.4.1** fixes the Mac's daily schedule, which stopped after the Mac app was updated. Nothing else
changes.

## Fixed

### Mac: the daily schedule after an update

- **What happened:** after the Mac app was replaced (for example 0.3.3 → 0.4.0), macOS stopped starting the daily
  schedule. It showed one crash report for Paperhue ("Launch Constraint Violation"), and after that the schedule
  quietly did not run. Your pages, settings and device were not affected.
- **Now:** Paperhue starts the schedule again by itself. Once it has not run for about half an hour, the next time
  you open Paperhue or switch to it, Paperhue registers it again.
- **Daily schedule…** (「每日排程…」) shows when the schedule last ran. If it has not run for over an hour, it asks
  you to press **Turn on / update** (「啟用／更新排程」), which starts it again and keeps your times.

## Upgrading from 0.4.0

- **Mac:**
  - Replace Paperhue in Applications. Your pages and settings are kept.
  - If macOS asks you to confirm the new download: **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway**.
  - Open Paperhue once after updating. macOS asks once for each calendar source whether Paperhue may use it: enter
    your Mac's password and choose **Always Allow**.
  - The update stops the schedule once more, and macOS may again show a crash report and "Paperhue can run in the
    background". Open Paperhue or switch to it again at least 35 minutes after you first opened 0.4.1, and it
    starts the schedule again. Or press **Turn on / update** once **Daily schedule…** asks for it.
  - If you turned the schedule off and on again on 0.4.0 to get it running, this still applies.
  - If the schedule was still stopped on 0.4.0, it takes one more round. Press **Turn on / update** in
    **Daily schedule…** right after you first open 0.4.1 (your times are kept). Then open Paperhue or switch to it
    again at least 35 minutes later.
- **Windows, Android and iPhone:** nothing changes. You can update or stay on 0.4.0.

## Download

- **Windows:** Paperhue.exe
- **Mac:** Paperhue-macOS.zip (macOS 14 or newer)
- **Android:** Paperhue-Android.apk
- **iPhone:** nothing to download. Open https://markhhm.github.io/ulani-epaper/ in the Bluefy browser.
